sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 350. Deal magic damage (Star) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 80 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for physical attacks by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for magic attacks by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 100 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fete Element (increases all stats by 100%, increases cost recovery speed by 10, Ability Power is boosted by 30 when attacking an enemy in Break) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases your character's max HP by 50% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 17000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 17000

Athena, Star of Grace or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
